validity.recommendation: Keep the row. Real, distinct GASCO transmission line; specs confirmed. No dedup needed against P6704 (sibling 5 km spur) or the GulfPub 'Raven-Idku' offshore production line.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed by multiple independent sources. The line was inaugurated 10-11 Jul 2023 (first phase in service May 2021) to carry gas from the Raven field (BP's West Nile Delta, North Alexandria offshore concession, Rashid area) into the Western Desert Gas Complex (WDGC) at El-Amreya, Alexandria. Egyptian Ministry of Petroleum 2022 results report (petroleum.gov.eg) explicitly: 'ربط غازات حقل ريفين على مجمع غازات الصحراء الغربية' via a 70 km line carrying 350 million cf/d. Egypt Oil & Gas and Egypt Today independently report GASCO built a 70 km / 30-inch line from the Raven field in the Rashid area to WDGC. youm7 (Arabic media) corroborates 70 km / 30 in to WDGC plus a separate 5 km / 18 in spur to the Ameriya butane plant. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a gas transmission trunk (70 km, 30 in, moving Mediterranean field gas into the national WDGC processing complex to diversify its feed beyond Western Desert gas) — not gathering/plant-internal, and it is gas (not oil/NGL/condensate). DUPLICATE: NOT a duplicate. (a) P6704 'Raven-Al Ameryia Gas Pipeline' (Rashid->Alexandria, 5 km, 18 in) is the SECOND-phase spur to the Ameriya LPG/butane plant explicitly described alongside this 70 km line in the same ministry project — a genuine sibling, not the same pipe. (b) GulfPub 'Raven - Idku Pipeline' (Raven field->Idku, bp, 16 in, 46 km, 2021) is the OFFSHORE field production/export line to the Idku terminal — a different physical pipe upstream of this onshore GASCO trunk. SPECS all corroborated (see fills): length 70 km (petroleum.gov.eg + Egypt Oil & Gas), diameter 30 in (youm7 + Egypt Oil & Gas), capacity 350 mmcf/d (petroleum.gov.eg + Egypt Oil & Gas), start 2021 (ministry + BP first-gas Apr 2021 + first-phase May 2021), FuelSource Raven field.

validity.recommendation: Fix End location: WDGC sits at El-Amreya, Alexandria governorate — NOT the Western Desert. Set EndLocation='Western Desert Gas Complex', End governorate='Alexandria'. Consider adding Operator='Egyptian Natural Gas Company (GASCO)'; the sources credit GASCO with building/operating the line, whereas the row lists only Owner='Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Co' (EGAS, GASCO's parent — plausible owner, but operator is unstated).
validity.researcher_notes: ATTRIBUTION caveat, not an existence problem. (1) End geography is mislabelled: EndPrefecture/District='Western Desert' is misleading — the 'Western Desert Gas Complex' is named for the gas it historically processed but is physically located at El-Amreya (Merghem area), west of Alexandria (youm7 headline says 'بالأسكندرية' / in Alexandria; tendersinfo, OGJ and GASCO all place WDGC at El-Amreya, Alexandria). End governorate should read Alexandria. (2) Operator vs owner: independent sources (Egypt Oil & Gas, Egypt Today, youm7) state GASCO (Egyptian Natural Gas Company) established and operates the line; the field is BP/DEA (West Nile Delta). GEM lists Owner='Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Co' (EGAS) at 100%. EGAS is GASCO's holding parent so EGAS ownership is defensible and not overwritten, but Operator (GASCO) is currently unrecorded and the existing Owner [ref] (youm7) actually names GASCO, not EGAS.

routes.corridor_desc: ~70 km line running WSW from the Raven-field onshore receiving point in the Rashid/Idku area (western Nile Delta Mediterranean fringe, Beheira) along the coastal strip past/south of Alexandria to the Western Desert Gas Complex at El-Amreya (Merghem), west of Alexandria. Endpoints are named and sourced; the exact routing between them is not published, so treat the corridor as a coastal-strip bound rather than a surveyed centreline. Straight-line Rashid->El-Amreya (~72 km) matches the stated 70 km, supporting this corridor.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from sourced named places: START = Rashid area (منطقة رشيد) where Raven field gas comes ashore (ministry report + Egypt Oil & Gas); Rashid/Rosetta city coords 31.404N,30.416E are a well-known place (defensible, approximate for the receiving point). END = Western Desert Gas Complex at El-Amreya, west of Alexandria (youm7 'بالأسكندرية'; OGJ/tendersinfo place WDGC at El-Amreya) — El-Amreya coords ~31.02N,29.80E are approximate from the named town, not a surveyed pipeline point. Idku terminal waypoint (~31.30N,30.29E) is the West Nile Delta gas landing area between Rashid and Alexandria. No coordinates fabricated; all are anchored to named, sourced places and marked approximate.

summary: P6703 confirmed real, correctly gas-transmission, distinct from P6704 (5 km Ameriya spur) and GulfPub Raven-Idku offshore line; all specs (70 km, 30 in, 350 mmcf/d, 2021) corroborated; caveat: End governorate 'Western Desert' is wrong (WDGC is at El-Amreya, Alexandria) and operator GASCO is unrecorded.
